{{Top|leg}}
The '''Andra family''' was an ancient family that was once a member of a [[Tapani Noble Houses|Tapani Noble House]] that disbanded around the time the [[Freeworlds Territory|Freeworlds]] ceded from the [[Expanse]]. The family survived into the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Andra (captain)|Andra]] served in the [[Freeworlds Common Navy]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
